text:
### Police Report Process  
**Step 1: Internal Notification**
- [ ] Notify Head of Financial Crime
- [ ] Notify Head of Legal
- [ ] Document decision to report  
**Step 2: File Police Report**
- [ ] Contact local police (non-emergency: 101 in UK)
- [ ] Provide case details, evidence
- [ ] Obtain police reference number
- [ ] Document in case file  
**Step 3: Evidence Management**
- [ ] Preserve evidence for police investigation
- [ ] Don't disturb suspected fraudster's account (police may monitor)
- [ ] Coordinate with police on customer communication
- [ ] Provide police with requested documents/data  
**Step 4: Follow-Up**
- [ ] Periodically contact police for case status
- [ ] Provide additional evidence if requested
- [ ] Document all communications

raw_entities.name: Police Report Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for reporting suspected fraud to local police, including internal notification, formal police report filing, evidence preservation and coordination, and ongoing follow-up with law enforcement. The process ensures proper documentation and coordination between the bank's financial crime and legal teams and police investigators.

raw_entities.name: Internal Notification
raw_entities.description: Initial step requiring notification of key stakeholders within the bank before filing a police report. Involves notifying the Head of Financial Crime and Head of Legal, and formally documenting the decision to report to police.

raw_entities.name: File Police Report
raw_entities.description: Step involving direct contact with local police to file a formal report. Includes providing case details and evidence, obtaining a police reference number for tracking, and documenting the report in the case file.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Management
raw_entities.description: Step focused on preserving evidence for police investigation and coordinating with law enforcement on account handling and customer communication. Includes refraining from disturbing the suspected fraudster's account to allow police monitoring and providing requested documents and data to police.
context: Don't disturb suspected fraudster's account (police may monitor)
Coordinate with police on customer communication

raw_entities.name: Follow-Up
raw_entities.description: Final step involving ongoing communication with police to track case progress and provide additional evidence as requested. Requires periodic contact with police and comprehensive documentation of all communications.
context: Periodically contact police for case status

raw_entities.name: Head of Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Senior role responsible for receiving notification of suspected fraud cases before police reporting and participating in the decision to escalate to law enforcement.

raw_entities.name: Head of Legal
raw_entities.description: Senior legal role responsible for receiving notification of suspected fraud cases and advising on the decision to report to police.

raw_entities.name: Local Police
raw_entities.description: External law enforcement authority responsible for receiving fraud reports, investigating cases, and requesting evidence and documentation from the bank. Contact via non-emergency number 101 in UK.
context: Coordinate with police on customer communication
Periodically contact police for case status

raw_entities.description: Investigation into suspected fraud activity that triggers the police reporting process. Involves preservation of evidence, coordination with law enforcement, and ongoing case management.
